2122486342735278097.en_summary: Now you're confusing dollars spent with what those dollars buy. The pie is real output, not a fixed pool of spending. A smartphone replaced a camera, GPS, music player, landline and encyclopedia for less than all of them together, so the same dollars buy far more. Spending power isn't fixed either. It comes from income, and income grows as productivity grows.
2122486342735278097.zh_summary: 現在你把花費的美元與那些美元購買的東西混淆了。餅是真實產出，而不是固定的支出池。智能手機以低於所有這些加起來的成本取代了相機、GPS、音樂播放器、固話和百科全書，因此同樣的美元能購買更多。支出能力也不是固定的。它來自收入，而收入隨生產力增長而增長。
